body:
Source: the ADLC principle-fidelity audit (delta.md, PR #486). This ticket remediates one of the eight root-cause "seams" that audit found — cases where the toolkit trusts the model at the boundary between a built gate and the deployed system.

SEAM 2 (high). P5 "verified"/"killed" verdicts and the loop-until-dry exit are model self-report: the verifier cannot execute anything, and a "dry pass" is satisfied by any non-empty string. The evidence PACKAGING is rigorous (revision-bound, content-hashed, re-hashed at assert) but the CONTENT is not reproduced. This contradicts F4/Principle 2 ("evidence or it didn't happen", symmetric for critics). Note: review-calibration already does this right (plants witness-verified by pass-on-original/fail-on-mutant) — port that discipline into the live loop.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOR
1. For every finding verdict that admits mechanical reproduction, the prosecute schema must require an executed-artifact reference: a "killed" finding requires a repro that exits non-zero on the pre-fix revision, a "fixed"/"verified" finding requires a test that fails on base and passes on head. Text-only proof is rejected for these classes.
2. The dry-pass / loop-until-dry exit condition must be computed from executed results (e.g. a recorded command + exit code the runner can re-run), not from the presence of prose. Keep model judgment ONLY where execution is structurally impossible, and label those verdicts distinctly as non-reproduced.
3. Preserve existing revision-binding and no-fabrication guarantees; do not weaken schema.mjs's anti-vacuous checks.

This ticket touches an enforcement package (packages/prosecute) — P5 is CROSS-MODEL GATED per the ADLC router: a same-model clean prosecute is not enough to merge.

## Acceptance Criteria

- The schema rejects a "killed" finding lacking an executed repro reference. verify: `node --test packages/prosecute/test/schema.test.mjs`
- The dry-pass exit is computed from a re-runnable command+exit-code, not a non-empty string. verify: `node --test packages/prosecute/test/run.test.mjs`
- A verified/fixed finding requires a fail-on-base/pass-on-head witness. verify: `node --test packages/prosecute/test/witness.test.mjs`
- Existing revision-binding and no-fabrication tests still pass. verify: `node --test packages/prosecute/test/*.test.mjs`

allow-suppression: none
title: P5 prosecution: require executed proof for verified/killed findings, not model text
